reported.analysis_population: Questionnaire completers at last follow-up: 79 patients (80 knees), table denominators BTB-LET n = 38 and BTB n = 42. Table and flowchart call these counts patients whereas narrative distinguishes patients and knees.

comparison_groups.assignment: BTB ACL reconstruction plus gracilis tendon lateral extra-articular tenodesis (modified Lemaire)

target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups
target.intended_effect_measure: Difference in mean subjective IKDC score

measurement.method: Patient-reported subjective International Knee Documentation Committee (IKDC) score

time_point_or_window.description: 19-year postoperative follow-up after ACL reconstruction; reported visit mean 19.4 years (range 19–20.2)

castoldi-2020.relation_rationale: Table 4 directly reports the requested subjective IKDC comparison, with means 82.4 (range 55.2-100) for BTB-LET and 81.1 (range 42.5-100) for BTB, P = .7. This is the 19-year postoperative visit, actually mean 19.4 years (19–20.2), rather than an exact uniform 19-year measurement. The available-case population with a postrandomization knee-replacement exclusion is narrower than the all-randomized assignment target. The abstract pooled mean 81.8 is not a complete arm comparison; the graft-failure subgroup comparison 72 versus 84.5 compares failure status rather than randomized surgery and is not the requested Result. No comparative effect estimate, SD or CI is reported; group means are retained without inventing precision or a reported mean difference.

ashar-2022.requested_outcome: One-week mean back pain intensity (0–10) at posttreatment, one month after baseline

reported.analysis_population: Available posttreatment observations: PRT 44 of 50 randomized, usual care 47 of 50. These descriptive means are distinct from the primary mixed-effects analysis described as including all randomized patients.

comparison_groups.assignment: Usual care (pooled across both randomization streams)

target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups
target.intended_effect_measure: Difference in posttreatment mean pain intensity, PRT versus usual care

measurement.method: Brief Pain Inventory Short Form single item: average back pain over the last week, numerical rating scale 0–10
measurement.metric: One-week mean back pain intensity (0–10) at posttreatment, one month after baseline

target.outcome_definition: One-week mean back pain intensity (0–10) at posttreatment, one month after baseline

time_point_or_window.description: Posttreatment assessment, one month after baseline fMRI; not the one-month follow-up after posttreatment

ashar-2022.relation_rationale: Select Table 2 posttreatment mean pain intensity for the requested PRT versus usual-care comparison. The target comparison and reported group values include only PRT and usual care. Main-report methods specify the single weekly-average BPI item at one month postbaseline. The At 1 mo table row is a later posttreatment follow-up and is not selected. The available-observation means make this narrower than the all-randomized assignment target. The reported 2.40-point reduction and g=-1.74 (Table 2 -1.75) are group-by-time change effects, not a raw posttreatment mean difference, and are not the selected quantity. Protocol version 4.4 describes approximately five weeks after baseline/randomization and a conditional four-item versus single-item BPI choice; these are retained as scope context rather than silently equated.
